full_text_en:
Guiding Case No. 233

Changzhou HongMou Petrochemical Storage Co., Ltd. et al. v. Ningbo TianMou Shipping Co., Ltd.
— Dispute over liability for damage caused by ship collision with a dock

(Discussed and adopted by the Judicial Committee of the Supreme People's Court, released on November 25, 2024)

Keywords: Civil / Liability for damage caused by ship collision with a dock / Fund for limitation of liability for maritime claims / Limitation claims / Dock operation loss / Priority in distribution

Ruling Gist

With respect to claims for compensation for damage to dock property caused by a ship collision and for corresponding losses such as dock operation losses arising therefrom, the person liable may limit its liability in accordance with Article 207, paragraph 1, item (1) of the Maritime Code of the PRC. Among the aforesaid claims for compensation, according to Article 210, paragraph 1, item (4) of the Maritime Code, only claims for compensation for damage to dock property, not including claims for compensation for dock operation losses arising therefrom, may be given priority in distribution.

Basic Facts

At approximately 20:00 on July 5, 2017, the vessel "Tian Mou 18," operated by Ningbo TianMou Shipping Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Ningbo TianMou Shipping Company), carrying 48,810 tons of slag, departed from Jingtang Port, Hebei, bound for Changzhou Port, Jiangsu. At approximately 22:00 on July 9, 2017, the bow of "Tian Mou 18" collided with the midship to aft part of the starboard side of the vessel "Shuang Mou Hai," which was berthed at Berth No. 3 of the Changzhou Mou Run Chemical Yangtze River Dock (hereinafter referred to as Mou Run Dock). Due to the squeezing of "Shuang Mou Hai," part of Mou Run Dock owned by Changzhou HongMou Petrochemical Storage Co., Ltd. (hereinafter referred to as Changzhou HongMou Storage Company) collapsed, pipelines were torn, and gas and liquid leaked from the pipelines and ignited. On December 25, 2017, the Changzhou Maritime Safety Administration issued a "Water Traffic Accident Investigation Conclusion," determining that "Tian Mou 18" bore full responsibility for the accident. As a result of the ship collision accident involved in the case, Changzhou HongMou Storage Company paid approximately RMB 69,247,776.87 in dock repair costs, suffered approximately RMB 65,844,974 in dock operation losses, and paid expenses for emergency rescue and salvage, among others.

After the accident occurred, HuaMou Property Insurance Co., Ltd., Jiangsu Branch (hereinafter referred to as HuaMou Insurance Jiangsu Branch), the insurer of the dock involved in the case, paid Changzhou HongMou Storage Company insurance compensation totaling RMB 55,380,000. Subsequently, Changzhou HongMou Storage Company agreed to transfer all rights and interests in the insured subject matter corresponding to the portion of the insurance compensation received to HuaMou Insurance Jiangsu Branch.

On July 31, 2017, Ningbo TianMou Shipping Company applied to the Wuhan Maritime Court to establish a fund for limitation of liability for maritime claims. On September 28, 2017, Changzhou HongMou Storage Company applied to the Wuhan Maritime Court for registration of the claims involved in the case. On December 27, 2017, the Wuhan Maritime Court issued Civil Ruling (2017) E 72 Min Te No. 39, granting Ningbo TianMou Shipping Company permission to establish a fund for limitation of liability for maritime claims in the amount of 2,442,041 Special Drawing Rights plus interest. Changzhou HongMou Storage Company, dissatisfied, appealed. On May 7, 2018, the Hubei High People's Court issued Civil Ruling (2018) E Min Zhong No. 619, upholding the civil ruling of the Wuhan Maritime Court. Subsequently, Ningbo TianMou Shipping Company lawfully established the fund for limitation of liability for maritime claims with the Wuhan Maritime Court by providing cash and guarantees. On July 27, 2018, the Wuhan Maritime Court issued Civil Ruling (2017) E 72 Min Te No. 59 (II), granting the application of Changzhou HongMou Storage Company for registration of claims.

On August 24, 2017, Changzhou HongMou Storage Company et al. filed a lawsuit with the Wuhan Maritime Court, requesting a judgment: that Ningbo TianMou Shipping Company compensate for all losses caused by the accident; and that the claims for dock repair costs and dock operation losses be given priority in distribution within the fund for limitation of liability for maritime claims established by Ningbo TianMou Shipping Company over other claims for non-personal injury compensation. HuaMou Insurance Jiangsu Branch applied to participate in the litigation as a co-plaintiff, requesting a judgment: that Ningbo TianMou Shipping Company compensate RMB 55,380,000 plus interest for dock repair costs; and that the aforesaid claim be given priority in distribution within the fund for limitation of liability for maritime claims established by Ningbo TianMou Shipping Company over other claims for non-personal injury compensation.

Judgment

The Wuhan Maritime Court rendered Civil Judgment (2017) E 72 Min Chu No. 1563 on July 29, 2020: 1. Ningbo TianMou Shipping Co., Ltd. shall compensate Changzhou HongMou Petrochemical Storage Co., Ltd. for dock repair costs in the amount of RMB 13,867,776.87 plus interest; 2. Ningbo TianMou Shipping Co., Ltd. shall compensate HuaMou Property Insurance Co., Ltd., Jiangsu Branch for dock repair costs in the amount of RMB 55,380,000 plus interest; 3. Ningbo TianMou Shipping Co., Ltd. shall compensate Changzhou HongMou Petrochemical Storage Co., Ltd. for maritime salvage costs in the amount of RMB 1,468,480 plus interest; 4. Ningbo TianMou Shipping Co., Ltd. shall compensate HuaMou Property Insurance Co., Ltd., Jiangsu Branch for maritime salvage costs in the amount of RMB 3,700,000 plus interest; 5. Dismiss the other claims of Changzhou HongMou Petrochemical Storage Co., Ltd.; 6. Dismiss the other claims of HuaMou Property Insurance Co., Ltd., Jiangsu Branch. The aforesaid compensation shall be paid in a lump sum within ten days after this judgment becomes effective and shall be distributed from the fund for limitation of liability for maritime claims established by Ningbo TianMou Shipping Co., Ltd., wherein the compensation under items 1 and 2 shall be given priority in distribution during the fund distribution.

After the first-instance judgment was rendered, Changzhou HongMou Petrochemical Storage Co., Ltd., dissatisfied, appealed, requesting that the first-instance judgment be revoked and that Ningbo TianMou Shipping Co., Ltd. be ordered to compensate Changzhou HongMou Petrochemical Storage Co., Ltd. for dock operation losses in the amount of RMB 65,844,974 plus interest, and that this claim be given priority in distribution within the fund for limitation of liability for maritime claims established by Ningbo TianMou Shipping Co., Ltd. The Hubei High People's Court, upon trial, held that the claim of Changzhou HongMou Petrochemical Storage Co., Ltd. for dock operation losses and interest was supported by facts and law and should be upheld; however, its request for priority distribution of this claim within the fund for limitation of liability for maritime claims lacked legal basis and was not supported. Accordingly, the Hubei High People's Court rendered Civil Judgment (2021) E Min Zhong No. 15 on August 11, 2021: 1. Revoke Civil Judgment (2017) E 72 Min Chu No. 1563 of the Wuhan Maritime Court; 2. Ningbo TianMou Shipping Co., Ltd. shall compensate Changzhou HongMou Petrochemical Storage Co., Ltd. for dock repair costs in the amount of RMB 13,867,776.87 plus interest; 3. Ningbo TianMou Shipping Co., Ltd. shall compensate HuaMou Property Insurance Co., Ltd., Jiangsu Branch for dock repair costs in the amount of RMB 55,380,000 plus interest; 4. Ningbo TianMou Shipping Co., Ltd. shall compensate Changzhou HongMou Petrochemical Storage Co., Ltd. for maritime salvage costs in the amount of RMB 1,468,480 plus interest; 5. Ningbo TianMou Shipping Co., Ltd. shall compensate HuaMou Property Insurance Co., Ltd., Jiangsu Branch for maritime salvage costs in the amount of RMB 3,700,000 plus interest; 6. Ningbo TianMou Shipping Co., Ltd. shall compensate Changzhou HongMou Petrochemical Storage Co., Ltd. for dock operation losses in the amount of RMB 65,844,974 plus interest; 7. Dismiss the other claims of Changzhou HongMou Petrochemical Storage Co., Ltd.; 8. Dismiss the other claims of HuaMou Property Insurance Co., Ltd., Jiangsu Branch. The aforesaid compensation shall be distributed from the fund for limitation of liability for maritime claims established by Ningbo TianMou Shipping Co., Ltd., wherein the compensation under items 2 and 3 shall be given priority in distribution during the fund distribution.

Reasoning

Limitation of liability for maritime claims is one of the unique legal systems under maritime law, referring to the system whereby the shipowner, operator, charterer, etc., as the person liable, may limit their liability to a certain amount in accordance with legal provisions when a maritime accident causes property damage or personal injury to others. Article 207 of the Maritime Code clearly defines the scope of limitation claims for which the person liable may limit its liability. Item (1) of paragraph 1 of that article provides that the person liable may limit its liability for claims for compensation for loss of life or personal injury occurring on board or in direct connection with the operation of the ship or with salvage operations, and for loss of or damage to property, including damage to harbor works, basins, waterways, and aids to navigation, as well as for resulting loss or damage caused therewith. In this case, Changzhou HongMou Storage Company suffered losses due to the ship collision accident involved, and Changzhou HongMou Storage Company has the right to demand compensation from the person liable. As the insurer of the dock involved, after fulfilling the corresponding insurance compensation obligations to Changzhou HongMou Storage Company, HuaMou Insurance Jiangsu Branch also has the right to demand compensation from the person liable within the scope of insurance compensation. The claims of Changzhou HongMou Storage Company and HuaMou Insurance Jiangsu Branch include dock repair costs, emergency rescue and salvage costs, and dock operation losses caused by the inability to operate normally due to severe damage to the dock. All these claims fall within the category of limitation claims as defined in the aforesaid legal provision, and therefore the person liable, Ningbo TianMou Shipping Company, has the right to limit its liability in accordance with that provision.

The limitation amount for maritime claims is the maximum compensation amount payable by the person liable for all limitation claims, including those for personal injury and non-personal injury. Article 210 of the Maritime Code provides for the calculation method of the limitation amount for maritime claims and the order of distribution for various types of limitation claims. Item (4) of paragraph 1 of that article provides: "Without prejudice to the right of claims for loss of life or personal injury under subparagraph (3), claims in respect of damage to harbor works, basins, waterways, and aids to navigation shall be given priority in distribution over other claims under subparagraph (2)." According to the aforesaid provision, among limitation claims for non-personal injury, claims in respect of damage to harbor works, basins, waterways, and aids to navigation may be given priority in distribution over other claims. The term "damage" in this provision refers only to direct property damage to harbor works, basins, waterways, and aids to navigation caused by the accident, and does not include other resulting losses caused by the accident. Accordingly, in this case, claims for compensation for dock repair costs resulting from the collision accident may be given priority in distribution, but claims for compensation for dock operation losses resulting from the accident cannot be given priority in distribution.

In summary, the dock operation losses requested for compensation by Changzhou HongMou Storage Company in this case shall be satisfied from the fund for limitation of liability for maritime claims established by Ningbo TianMou Shipping Company, but cannot be given priority over other claims for non-personal injury compensation.

Relevant Legal Provisions

Article 207, Article 210 of the Maritime Code of the PRC
